permissions.name: game:play
permissions.description: Create games, accept invitations and play them

permissions.name: game:admin
permissions.description: See every game, and delete any of them

settings.name: autosave_seconds
settings.description: How often a running game with unsaved changes is saved. 0 turns automatic saving off; a game type can set its own

settings.name: idle_seconds
settings.description: How long a running game with nobody connected is kept before it is saved and stopped. 0 keeps it running until it is deleted or the server stops

settings.name: max_state_bytes
settings.description: The largest a game's saved state may be. A save over this is refused

settings.name: max_settings_bytes
settings.description: The largest a game's settings may be

settings.name: max_games_per_user
settings.description: How many games one user may own. 0 is unlimited

groups.name: kempo-game:player
groups.description: Can create games, accept invitations and play. This is the group that gates the feature: nobody can play without it

groups.name: kempo-game:administrator
groups.description: Can play, and can see and delete every game
